title: System Monitor Sensor widget auto-scales temperature graph to 0-5°C despite valid sensor readings
line: Line charts with an NVIDIA GPU temperature and an automatic range now scale to the real temperatures instead of 0-5 °C on drivers that report the target temperature as N/A
explanation: ksystemstats sets the NVIDIA temperature sensor's maximum from nvidia-smi --query as GPU Target Temperature plus the shutdown T.Limit margin. On the reporter's RTX 5070 Ti with driver 615 the target temperature is N/A and the shutdown margin is -5 C, so atoi read the target as 0 and the maximum became 5 °C. A line chart with an automatic Y range uses the sensors' maximum, so it drew 0-5 °C while the legend showed ~40 °C. The change parses the target temperature with toInt(&ok) and only sets the maximum when it is a number; otherwise the maximum stays unset and the chart scales to the data.

commits.message:
gpu/nvidia: don't read an N/A target temperature as 0

Some drivers report the GPU Target Temperature as N/A, which was read
as 0, so the maximum became only the shutdown margin (5 °C) and charts
with an automatic range drew 0 to 5 °C. Leave the maximum unset then.

BUG: 525406

media.caption: Pure master, faked RTX 5070 Ti (driver 615 nvidia-smi output, Target Temperature N/A): line chart with only the GPU temperature and automatic range draws 0-5 °C while the legend shows 39 °C
With the fix, same setup: the chart scales to 0-40 °C and the GPU temperature line is visible
Pure master, the reporter's case: CPU and GPU temperatures in one chart, still 0-5 °C with nothing drawn
With the fix: CPU (~50 °C) and GPU (~38 °C) lines both drawn, range 0-65 °C

review.text: Clean, minimal root-cause fix in ksystemstats that safely parses NVIDIA's GPU Target Temperature with toInt(&ok) and leaves maxTemperature unset when drivers report N/A instead of computing 0 + 5 °C. It safely handles malformed or empty lines, preserves existing behavior for numeric target temperatures and legacy shutdown temperature lines, passes all ksystemstats autotests, and is thoroughly verified with before/after charts.

reviews.text: Clean, minimal root-cause fix in ksystemstats that safely parses NVIDIA's GPU Target Temperature with toInt(&ok) and leaves maxTemperature unset when drivers report N/A instead of computing 0 + 5 °C. It safely handles malformed or empty lines, preserves existing behavior for numeric target temperatures and legacy shutdown temperature lines, passes all ksystemstats autotests, and is thoroughly verified with before/after charts.

Correct diagnosis in the right repo: a sensor maximum of exactly 5 can only come from the Target Temperature line parsing to 0 plus the -5 C shutdown margin, and the automatic range then honours that bogus maximum. The fix parses the value strictly and leaves the maximum unset otherwise, which is minimal, safe for the numeric and old Shutdown Temp formats (both regression-checked) and makes the chart scale to the data as the reporter expects. The reporter never pasted the Target Temperature line, so N/A is inferred, but the faked driver-615 output and the before/after charts for both the GPU-only and CPU+GPU cases are convincing; an optional nit is also rejecting a parsed value of 0.
